name: Cliff of Bandiagara (Land of the Dogons)
description: In central Mali, the Bandiagara Escarpment is a sandstone wall about 150 km long that rises roughly 500 m above the sandy plains below. Dogon villages cling to its base and top, with mud-walled houses, granaries and communal meeting shelters called Togu Na. Older Tellem buildings remain in the rock, and masked dances and ancestor rituals still continue here.
